**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Madam
I am much obliged for your offer but I am afraid you have been forestalled as we have had two papers upon Palermo and Taormina by Miss [Florence Freeman](../persons.html#524), written and we could hardly go over the same ground[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: A tiny piece from an envelope is pasted in with the address ‘The Revd/ J.J.

Stone/ Windsor’.

The recipient was perhaps a member of his household, or the letter may not belong to it.

[^2]: Florence Freeman, \'Taormina and its Neighbourhood\' MP 3s 2 (December 1891), 617-29; and \'Palermo and its Neighbourhood\' MP 3s 6 (September 1893), 296-310.
